adaSourceCharset.description: The character set of Ada source files (gdb's `set ada source-charset`).

coreFile.description: A core file to load, as gdb's `core-file` command does. Use it when neither `pid` nor `target` is given.

debuggerArgs.description: More arguments for the gdb program, after `-i dap` (for example `-nx` to skip the gdbinit files).

debuggerPath.description: The gdb program to run (14 or newer). It replaces the setting `gdb.path` for this configuration.

pid.description: The id of the process to attach to. `${command:pickProcess}` lists the processes and asks for one. `pid` is used before `target`, and `target` before `coreFile`.

program.description: The program that runs in the process. gdb finds it by itself for many local processes, but not for most remote targets.

target.description: The target to connect to, as gdb's `target remote` command takes it (for example `localhost:2345` for a gdbserver).

adaSourceCharset.description: The character set of Ada source files (gdb's `set ada source-charset`).

args.description: The arguments of the program. A text is split into words as a shell does.

cwd.description: The folder gdb changes to before it loads the program; the program inherits it. The default is the folder of the workspace.

debuggerArgs.description: More arguments for the gdb program, after `-i dap` (for example `-nx` to skip the gdbinit files).

debuggerPath.description: The gdb program to run (14 or newer). It replaces the setting `gdb.path` for this configuration.

env.description: Environment variables for the program, added to the environment of Emetos (gdb itself takes the environment exactly as it is given).

program.description: The program to debug, built with debug information (`-g`).

stopAtBeginningOfMainSubprogram.description: Stop at the beginning of the main function, as gdb's `start` command does.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first instruction of the program, as gdb's `starti` command does.
